device_access: none (no ssh/scp/board, no submit, no program/flash)
board_execution: PENDING: preparation only; no RK3588, Rocket or FPGA execution was performed

grid.order: row-major, A class outer (row), B class inner (column)
grid.lane_mapping: case c covers A rows 2c and 2c+1; lane 0..15 uses A row 2c with B class 0..15, lane 16..31 uses A row 2c+1 with B class 0..15; global pair index = 16*A index + B index

cases.description: FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A00=0x0000 (+0); lanes 16-31 A01=0x8000 (-0); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half
FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A02=0x7c00 (+inf); lanes 16-31 A03=0xfc00 (-inf); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half

FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A04=0x7e00 (quiet NaN, payload 0x200); lanes 16-31 A05=0x7c01 (signaling NaN, payload 0x001); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half

FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A06=0x0001 (minimum positive subnormal); lanes 16-31 A07=0x03ff (maximum positive subnormal); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half

FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A08=0x0400 (minimum positive normal); lanes 16-31 A09=0x7bff (maximum positive finite); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half
FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A10=0x3c00 (+1.0); lanes 16-31 A11=0xbc00 (-1.0); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half
FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A12=0x3800 (+0.5); lanes 16-31 A13=0xb800 (-0.5); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half
FP16 FDIV raw operand-class truth table, 32 lanes, width=3; lanes 0-15 A14=0x4000 (+2.0); lanes 16-31 A15=0xc000 (-2.0); B classes 0-15 in order in each 16-lane half

validation.scope: device-free structural validation; not SystemVerilog, not FPGA, not RK3588 silicon and not a numerical oracle

notes: All cases are READY with oracle none: this is a device characterization truth table.
No output.bin or expected.bin is included; the later worker writes output.bin from the real device.
Raw pair order is preserved in each case's pairs list and in the lane order of input-a.bin/input-b.bin.
The 22-QWORD stream is 17 non-padding commands plus five zero-valued donor padding fields.
QWORDs 14/15/16 are zero placeholders and require all three value32 patches before submit.
